name: [Collectibles] Hololive OCG Cards
teaser: 200+ Cards from the Hololive Official Card Game. Based on Krackasourus' Collectables: Anime Girls mod.
description_html:
This mod is based on the work of Krackasourus, licensed under the MIT License. The original work can be found at Collectables: Anime Girls

Some more collectible cards for the fellows out there that like ’em.

Description

This is my first time trying to mod SPT. If something’s broken or if the loot spawns are weird or anything just let me know and I’ll try my best to fix the issue.

This mod adds ~200 cards across 10 different rarities and a Booster Pack from Cover Corp’s Hololive OCG. The most common cards can be sold for around 8k but the rarer cards can go for tens or hundreds of thousands.

Preview:

Install Instructions

Install Color Converter API

Drag the user folder from this mod’s archive into your SPT directory.
